periods.label: Immortal dragon goddess
periods.species: ancient dragon goddess / possessing lineage spirit

status.notes: withdraws after pact; agrees to wait roughly 100 years for China's natural lifespan

periods.summary: Gedronika descends by using China/Rasputina as a bloodline coordinate, possesses her body, and begins a disaster attack that arrests atomic motion and would freeze Tokyo. Kinji cuts off her tail with Yamato after Angelica and Aria open a route; she accepts a pact brokered by Livia and departs.

china.summary: uses her as coordinate and temporary body

kinji.summary: fears and respects Kinji after he can wound/kill her vessel

aria.summary: Aria participates in the charge to stop her

angelica-starr.summary: Angelica anticipates and opens the assault

key_events.summary: possesses China and declares herself in Odaiba
tail is severed and pact is formed to spare Tokyo/China
